context: Map every non-local Vitest input, add only the missing dependency paths, and test changed-filter, fixture-only, and unrelated-path decisions.
description: The explorer-vitest path group omits .github/workflows/pr.yml, .github/path-filters.yml, tests/unit/core/tuning/fixtures/tuning_mode_vocabulary.yaml, and tests/parity/fixtures/chart_ids.json even though Vitest reads them. Configuration or shared-fixture changes can therefore skip the gate that should detect them.

anti_patterns.why: the filter can skip its own change

anti_patterns.instead: add one classifier case per omitted path
anti_patterns.why: the misses are workflow and fixture paths

preserves.behavior: Explorer source and build inputs remain covered
Fixture changes cannot bypass their consumer gate
Unrelated Python-only PRs still skip Node

verifications.command: uv run -- python -c 'import yaml; p=yaml.safe_load(open(".github/path-filters.yml")); paths=set(p["explorer-vitest"]); assert {".github/workflows/pr.yml",".github/path-filters.yml","tests/unit/core/tuning/fixtures/tuning_mode_vocabulary.yaml","tests/parity/fixtures/chart_ids.json"} <= paths'
verifications.description: Filter contains workflow, filter, tuning, and chart dependencies

work_units.evidence: Audited Results Explorer Vitest consumers: chartRegistry parity tests read tests/parity/fixtures/chart_ids.json; tuningModeVocabulary tests read tests/unit/core/tuning/fixtures/tuning_mode_vocabulary.yaml; the PR gate is governed by .github/workflows/pr.yml and the shared classifier in .github/path-filters.yml. These four paths are the omitted non-local inputs.

Added only the four missing explicit explorer-vitest paths to .github/path-filters.yml and added four parameterized classifier regressions plus an unrelated Python negative case in tests/unit/workflows/test_pr_workflow_path_classifier.py. YAML verification and the focused workflow classifier file pass (25 tests).
work_units.summary: Add minimal filter paths and classifier regressions

work_units.evidence: Exact YAML path-set verification passes; full tests/unit/workflows suite passes (190 passed); focused classifier tests pass (25 passed); Ruff check/format and git diff --check pass. The unrelated Python path remains explorer-vitest skipped while each four omitted paths now arms the gate.
